purpose: Assess whether the predeclared allocation-separated source yields enough reviewable negative candidates

crop.ranking: Descending confidence, then sequence, frame index and prediction index

annotations: Source existence flag 0 only; UAV-free status remains unverified until independent review
timing: Version2 recorded prospectively after observing version1 and before version2 predictions.
shortfall_rule: Report insufficient proposals. Retain these rules and outcomes before proposing any new threshold, source or sampling version.
paper_use: Diagnostic only. E2/E3 still require a prospective source amendment and 512 independently verified matched crops per arm.
approval_source: Researcher requested continued work and explicitly required full allocation-block separation

amendment.reason: Assess candidate supply at the existing official operating confidence .25. The .50 diagnostic threshold was an initial engineering choice, not a required E2/E3 scientific condition.
amendment.allowed_change: Confidence .50 to .25 only; preserve model, cohort, crop count rules and all version1 results.
amendment.interpretation: Exploratory source-development diagnostic. Preserve both outcomes without treating threshold selection as an official causal experiment.
